questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many distinct real roots does the equation $x^4 - 62x^2 + 177 = 0$ possess?
questions.solution: Factoring $(x^2 - 59)(x^2 - 3) = 0$ with $59 \neq 3 > 0$ yields $4$ distinct real roots $\pm\sqrt{59}, \pm\sqrt{3}$.
questions.explanation: Apply discriminant & nature of roots techniques in Statistics & Probability (Total Probability Theorem).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 61x + 60 = 0$ and $x^2 - 5x + k = 0$ share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (5) + k = 0 \implies k = 4$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Statistics & Probability (Bayes Theorem & Conditional Probability).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $2x^2 + 122x + 10 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ have both roots in common, find the value of $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{122} = \frac{q}{10} \implies p = 61,\; q = 5 \implies p + q = 66$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Statistics & Probability (Binomial Probability Distribution).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.category: Location of Roots on Real Axis
questions.question: Find the largest integral value of $m$ for which the number $x = 6$ lies strictly between the two real roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 12x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 6$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(6) < 0 \implies 6^2 - 2(6^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 36$, so largest integer is $35$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Statistics & Probability (Variance under Linear Transformation).
